art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat sketchbook look with pencil shading; the bottle is rendered realistically with a soft contact shadow so it pops over the drawing.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 ad that looks like a page from a sketchbook, on warm cream textured paper (#FBF3DC). TOP: a very bold, extra-bold uppercase geometric sans headline in solid near-black on one line across the full width. CENTER: two hand-drawn pencil-sketch illustrations (loose confident lines, crosshatch shading, realistic proportions) of the same young woman standing front view side by side, shown from the head to just below the knees, dark hair in a messy bun, wearing the same modest fitted dark tank top and full-length dark leggings. The two figures have exactly the same body shape, size and proportions; only posture, facial expression and tint color differ. LEFT FIGURE: shoulders slightly slouched, tired half-closed eyes, flat low-energy expression, skin shaded with muted terracotta-red hatching (#B5452C). RIGHT FIGURE: upright relaxed posture, bright eyes, soft confident smile, skin shaded with warm golden-yellow hatching (#C9A441 / #F2DC4A). CALLOUTS: on the far left margin, three handwritten two-line notes in a neat casual marker font, each with a larger terracotta-red keyword on the first line and a smaller near-black second line, joined to the left figure by thin dashed terracotta lines: the first points to her head, the second to her stomach, the third to her legs and has small hand-drawn dash rays around it. Mirrored on the far right margin, three handwritten two-line notes with a larger gold keyword and a smaller near-black second line, joined to the right figure by thin dashed gold lines at head, stomach and legs; the third has small hand-drawn four-point sparkles around it. BOTTOM CENTER: the product, rendered photorealistically, standing front view between and slightly in front of the two figures, with a soft contact shadow, its base near the bottom edge. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. No price, no CTA button, no logo outside the product label, no stars, no 'before/after' labels, no extra text.
